Objective: Verify simultaneous debit requests serialize via Oracle row locks (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE), preventing lost updates and overdrafts
Pre-conditions: Account funded with $500.00; valid JWT token
Test Steps / Input: Fire 10 parallel threads simultaneously via CountDownLatch, each withdrawing $100.00
Expected Result: Exactly 5 succeed (201), 5 rejected (422 Insufficient Balance). Final balance is exactly $0.00 (never negative). Zero lost updates.

Objective: Verify simultaneous cross-transfers (A -> B and B -> A) do not trigger ORA-00060 deadlocks or frozen threads
Test Steps / Input: Fire 10 parallel threads: 5 transfers (A -> B) and 5 transfers (B -> A) at the exact same millisecond
Expected Result: Lexicographical UUID lock ordering acquires locks in deterministic order. All succeed. Thread dump reports 'Found 0 deadlocks'.
Execution Method: VisualVM Thread Dump / Parallel PowerShell loop

Objective: Verify JVM heap memory stabilizes under sustained transaction load without accumulating uncollected objects in Old Gen
Test Steps / Input: Execute continuous loop of 50-100 transaction requests, then trigger Garbage Collection
Expected Result: Heap shows saw-tooth pattern; drops back to baseline (~60-90 MB). Redis offloads idempotency keys off-heap with 24h TTL.

Objective: Verify JDBC connections are returned to HikariCP in finally blocks, preventing connection starvation
Test Steps / Input: Stress test with 30 concurrent mutation requests; inspect Hikari metrics
Expected Result: Active connections spike during burst and drop back to 0 idle. Zero ConnectionLeakException warnings in logs.

Objective: Verify funds enter an account and update balance atomically
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate with txnType=DEPOSIT, amount=5000.00
Expected Result: Status 201 CREATED. Oracle ACCOUNT_MASTER balance becomes 5000.00. TRANSACTION_MASTER row created. Postgres writes 1 CREDIT row.

Objective: Verify funds leave an account safely
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate with txnType=WITHDRAWAL, amount=1500.00
Expected Result: Status 201 CREATED. Oracle ACCOUNT_MASTER balance becomes 3500.00. Postgres writes 1 DEBIT row.

Objective: Verify funds move between accounts without creation or destruction of money
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate with txnType=TRANSFER, amount=1500.50, acct1 -> acct2
Expected Result: Status 201 CREATED. Acct 1 balance = 1999.50, Acct 2 balance = 1500.50. Sum is conserved. Postgres writes 2 rows (1 DEBIT + 1 CREDIT).

Objective: Verify duplicate requests with the same idempotency key return cached response without double-charging
Test Steps / Input: Re-submit identical POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate request with same idempotencyKey
Expected Result: Status 200/201. Returns cached response from Redis. Balance is NOT incremented a second time. Zero duplicate DB rows.

Objective: Verify account balance can never become negative at the database or API level
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate with txnType=WITHDRAWAL, amount=10000.00
Expected Result: Rejected with 422 Unprocessable Entity (InsufficientBalanceException). Balance remains 3499.50. Oracle constraint ck_account_master_nonneg protected.

Objective: Verify an account cannot transfer funds to itself
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate with accountId == counterpartyAccountId, txnType=TRANSFER
Expected Result: Rejected with 400 Bad Request. Enforced by service validation and Oracle constraint ck_txn_diff_accounts.

Objective: Verify transactions require positive amounts
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate with amount=-50.00 or amount=0.00
Expected Result: Rejected with 400 Bad Request. Blocked by JSR-380 @Positive annotation and Oracle check constraint ck_txn_amount_positive.

Objective: Verify transfers between different currencies are caught when ForEx service is offline
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate with txnType=TRANSFER from PHP account to USD account
Expected Result: Rejected with 400 Bad Request ('Cross-currency transfer from PHP to USD is not supported without ForEx service'). Prevents 1:1 currency corruption.

Objective: Verify ledger_mutation_audit table cannot be modified even via direct SQL
Test Steps / Input: docker exec postgres-db psql: UPDATE ledger_mutation_audit SET mutation_amount = 0 WHERE txn_type = 'DEPOSIT';
Expected Result: PostgreSQL trigger trg_ledger_mutation_audit_append_only aborts statement with 'ERROR: ledger_mutation_audit is append-only'.

Objective: Verify ledger_mutation_audit records cannot be erased
Test Steps / Input: docker exec postgres-db psql: DELETE FROM ledger_mutation_audit WHERE txn_type = 'TRANSFER';
Expected Result: PostgreSQL trigger aborts execution with append-only error. Immutability guaranteed.

Objective: Verify Oracle rolls back master balance if PostgreSQL audit insert fails
Pre-conditions: Simulate PostgreSQL connection failure during mutation
Test Steps / Input: Initiate POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate while PostgreSQL write fails
Expected Result: Phase 2 fails. Spring @Transactional compensator catches error, rolls back Oracle balance delta, marks TRANSACTION_MASTER as ROLLED_BACK. Zero data drift.

Objective: Verify onboarding of retail customer with personal details and BCrypt password
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/auth/register with first_name, last_name, email, birthDate, password
Expected Result: Status 201 CREATED. Returns customerId UUID. Records created in Oracle CUSTOMER_MASTER and APP_USER_MASTER.

Objective: Verify email uniqueness constraint in customer master record
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/auth/register with identical email address
Expected Result: Rejected with 409 Conflict. Oracle unique constraint uq_customer_master_email prevents duplicate records.

Objective: Verify credential authentication and stateless token generation
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password
Expected Result: Status 200 OK. Returns signed HMAC-SHA384 JWT Bearer token containing customerId and role claims with 1-hour expiration.

Objective: Verify logged out tokens are invalidated via Redis blacklist filter
Test Steps / Input: POST /api/auth/logout, then call GET /api/accounts/{id}/balance with the same token
Expected Result: Logout returns 200 OK (token pushed to Redis blacklist). Subsequent request immediately rejected with 401 Unauthorized by API Gateway.

Objective: Verify transactions emit events to Kafka without blocking the synchronous REST response
Test Steps / Input: Execute successful transfer via POST /api/v1/ledger/mutate
Expected Result: Transaction completes and returns 201 CREATED in <100ms. Publishes TransactionCompletedEvent to Kafka topic 'transaction.completed' asynchronously.

Objective: Verify downstream notification-service consumes Kafka events and writes audit trail
Test Steps / Input: Inspect notification-service logs and query PostgreSQL notification_audit table
Expected Result: Notification Service consumes event. New row inserted into PostgreSQL NOTIFICATION_AUDIT with status 'SENT' and customerId.
